request.style: English, Norwegian revival song from the prayer house tradition, warm middle-aged male voice, accordion and acoustic guitar, simple waltz in 3/4, a small congregation joining on the refrain, nostalgic and heartfelt, 92 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Far off in a foreign land
I sat with nothing left
I thought about my father's house
And all the good I left
I will get up and go to him
And say to him today
Father, I have sinned against heaven and before you

[Chorus]
He ran to meet me on the road
He threw his arms around my neck
This son of mine was dead and is alive again
He was lost and is found

[Verse]
I am no longer worthy
To be called your son
But father called for the best robe
A ring upon my hand
And sandals on my feet
And the feast was all made ready
For this son of mine was dead and is alive

[Chorus]
He ran to meet me on the road
He threw his arms around my neck
This son of mine was dead and is alive again
He was lost and is found
